calibration.provenance: Market-calibrated slope k=0.42134147483007134 fitted by session 7177d07f (retained in data/7177d07f/board.json: 'Valve Glicko curve, calibrated slope k=0.4213...') and reused by desk session 3e1be203. Canonical engine (scripts/f7279a54/core.py) defines the same Valve Glicko curve with k as a free slope but its current fit is unfitted (n=3 pairs < 6 minimum, k forced to 1.0). finals/ publishes the calibrated k as its originated line and the k=1.0 Valve-raw value as sensitivity, so no number depends on hiding the disagreement.
calibration.formula: p(A) = sigmoid(k * C * (ptsA - ptsB)), C = g*ln(10)/400, g = 1/sqrt(1+3*Q^2*RD^2/pi^2), Q=ln(10)/400, RD=75 (Valve model/glicko.js + fit.js defaults, as implemented in scripts/f7279a54/core.py).

climb_rules.text: SAFE pick = higher win probability. CLIMB (switch) pick is published only when ALL hold: underdog win probability >= 35% (not a lottery ticket), leverage = probability - crowd ownership >= 15pp, and >= 2 independently verified context flags favour the underdog (H2H win within 90 days, map-pool edge on a likely map, rest/maps edge, opponent roster disruption/stand-ins, underdog form run). A favourite the crowd is fading is labelled FREE DIFFERENTIAL (safe pick already contrarian - no switch needed). Rows meeting price+leverage but lacking verified flags or crowd data are WATCHLIST only. Max 3 switches per day; Day 4 backtest (1 safe win / 1 rejected-dog win) is published on twc.html - the floor is NOT retro-fitted to it.
